as_told.title: Rumours that Hughes's Glomar Explorer recovered objects from the seafloor

plain: There are rumours that the Glomar Explorer, a huge deep-sea ship built in 1974 for the Hughes Corporation and sent out into the Pacific, was really meant to go down to the seafloor and find strange objects, like a craft said to rest under the sea. Michels raises this himself, without naming a source, in two episodes. In one he only wonders aloud about the ship and the big company behind it. In the other he says plainly that the rumours have it searching for objects like the one his guest describes, which would mean a hidden purpose behind a famous ship.
